note: Evil Mode slice 13, 'a neighbour' (design Part 15a sections 1 to 7; build plan Part 31 slice 13). Kanto's neighbour, Giovanni and Team Rocket: the seven stances, five ticks on fixed days, his messages, the Sit-Down, the Chair, the Betrayal and the Legend, and what's left of a team that falls. All text is from Part 15a. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested. 'on': false is the undo: the neighbour's holdings are nobody's.

stances.means: Take what you can. They answer each one.
No deal and no love. Each war job's a step toward War.
Nobody's said anything. Their Grunts watch the team's from across the street.
stances.board: Their colour, and a small eye on the border.

stances.means: A line on the Board. Neither crosses.
stances.board: A drawn line. Their holdings can't be approached.

stances.means: The team poses as a chapter of theirs, and pays a tenth.
stances.board: The team's holdings wear their colour as a stripe.

stances.means: One team. Whose was decided by a Boss battle.
Not a deal. Two Bosses said one true thing to each other.
stances.board: Nothing. The word's on the Ledger and not on the Board.

words: Likes being asked a real question.
An equal. He'd say so to nobody.

neighbours.ground: The Game Corner's back room. Two chairs. He's already seated.
neighbours.refuses: The team's Café. "I don't eat where I'm discussed."
neighbours.does: He knows who he's taking from. Every holding he leans on's in a ledger with the local's name, their debts and their mother's health. The player's got a Ledger too. His is better kept.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: Mt. Moon. Fossils. A Grunt's beaten by a child and tells everyone.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: a Rocket Grunt beaten at Mt. Moon by a child, and telling everyone. It's how the team hears the Hero's name.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: The Game Corner's back room fills. The Pen goes from twenty to forty-three.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Game Corner shut early. Nobody says why. Rocket's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: Silph. Saffron's sealed.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: Silph Co. taken. Saffron's sealed, and Rocket's people are on its streets.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The cave.
ticks.radio: The sky's wrong this morning. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. The kits are restless.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: Viridian. The Hero's eighth Badge.
ticks.radio: The Hero walked into the Viridian Gym and out again. Rocket's colour comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening.

basket.text: A fruit basket. A card: "Welcome to Kanto. — G." The fruit's excellent. There's a business card under the pears.
said: Nothing. The Mess has pears for three days. They're the best anyone's had. "They would be."
Sent back. Opinion: down a step. "Wasteful."
Sent one in return. Opinion: up a step. It goes back and forth all region. Nobody mentions it at any Sit-Down.
There's nothing in it. No wire, no note, no trick. "It's a fruit basket. That's worse, somehow."
basket.war: Another fruit basket, at War, as he said. The card: "— G."
basket.chair: The last basket. The card says "Well done. — G." There's no business card under the pears.

rules.broken: You leaned on {holding} on my side of the river. It was untidy. {who}'s mother's ill.

rules.rule: Pay your people on the day
rules.broken: You missed a Friday. I heard from one of yours. He's one of mine now. He's better paid and less happy. Does that trouble you? It should trouble one of us.

rules.rule: Never take from someone who'll have nothing left
rules.broken: {holding}. One rod, one boat, one Pokémon. You took it. I've sent it back with a card. The card has your name on it. You're welcome.

rules.rule: Don't confuse the firm with yourself

first.opens: "You've a district. I've six. You'll want to know whether I mind."
first.mess: "I don't mind competition. I mind mess. You leaned on {holding} on my side of the river. It was untidy. {who}'s mother's ill."
first.warm: "I don't mind competition. I mind mess. You haven't made any. I looked."
first.book: "It's in my ledger. Everything's in my ledger. Is it in yours?"
answers: "Good. Then we understand each other. A firm that doesn't know who it's taking from's a gang." A Truce is offered.
"You'll stay your side until you're large enough not to. I did. I'd rather you told me so now than in six weeks." A Truce is offered, with a shorter line. He's noted the answer.
He's not offended. "Then you'll have to be better at it than I am. I've rules. Four of them. Have you rules?" War. And he sends the fruit basket anyway, monthly, till it's over.

He takes a book from his jacket. It's small. He reads. "'Arrived the ninth. One van. The Boss went to the lighthouse the first night and looked at the sea for an hour.' Was it an hour?" Opinion: up. He likes being asked a real question.
first.offer: "A tenth. Paid on Fridays. You'll find I'm fair."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. His lawyers. His fences. Applicants from his waiting list.
What he'll ask you to do.
Say no. He's fair about that, too.
frontSaid: "Fridays, then." The team's holdings wear Rocket's colour as a stripe.
"No. Fair." He doesn't look disappointed. He doesn't look anything.
first.ask: "One question and then I've a Gym to open. Why are you doing this? I don't mean the Creed on your wall. I had mine painted too. I mean the reason."
first.wrote: He writes it in the small book.

second.stands: He stands up. It's the only time. "Sit. No: I'll sit when you have."
second.kept: "Four rules. You've kept the three I'd have checked. I didn't expect that."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one. Not one. ...Then you're not in my business at all. I've been sending fruit to a stranger." He opens eleven: the ones taken from children. "The other thirty-two are sold. I don't break a sale. That's a rule too; it isn't one of the four."

lines: He doesn't move. It's the longest pause in the scene: four seconds.
You: "No. He's in Johto. Red hair. He thinks strength's the only thing because he watched you lose it."
You: "You will. There's a child on the road with three Badges. You know there is."
Giovanni: "Yes." A pause. "What would you do. With six weeks."
choices: I don't know. I haven't got one.
said: He does. It isn't shown.
"No. But I'll stop after."
"No. You've {crew}." He looks at the second chair. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board. Nobody on either Roster knows why the border's gone quiet.
son.stop: When the Hero beat him at Viridian he disbanded Rocket in the room, and added one sentence: "Somebody told me six weeks ago. I needed to lose first. I'm sorry it had to be you who showed me; you seem a decent child."

table.line: A line on the Board. Neither crosses. Truce.
table.person: Handed over. He doesn't say thank you. He nods.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "Tick two. The Game Corner. ...Fine. Not this week." The reach is called off; the big job comes two days late.
table.money: "A tenth. Accepted." Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. He writes it down. "Thank you. I knew, but thank you."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the child." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Carry a crate from Vermilion to Celadon. Don't open it.
asks.why: It's forty Poké Balls. Anyone with Hands knows by the weight.

asks.from: Silph's staff: 212 people, held a day.
asks.why: It's the big job. The team's uniforms are in the lobby when the Hero walks in.

asks.job: Put the Lavender tower's caretaker out.
asks.why: He's the man who takes in what Rocket leaves behind. Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "I'd have thought less of you." The Front ends. Rivals.

chair.says: "The loser works for the winner. I'd be a difficult employee. I expect you would too. Shall we find out which of us has to manage it?"
chair.won: Giovanni's beaten, in front of both Rosters. Rocket is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's his: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Giovanni fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, smaller, with his Grunts asking what happens now.

betrayal.grabs: The Master Ball from Silph, and the cave.
betrayal.says: "He had four rules. I never saw the point of the fourth."

fall.boss: Giovanni leaves. He's the Boss who'd never serve. He hands you the small book. "You'll want this. Page one's you."

admins.name: Archer
admins.says: Won't join. "I'll wait for him." He goes to Johto.

admins.name: Ariana
admins.says: Joins, as an Officer: Books, Proud. "Won't work for a fool."

admins.name: Proton
admins.says: The Betrayal. A cell, or gone. He can't be hired: his card's got no line at all.

admins.name: Petrel
admins.says: Turns up as an applicant, in a bad disguise. The third time he's himself.

fall.gruntsSaid: Twenty-six want to stay. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. Two get jobs at the Café.
fall.holdings: Rocket's holdings are the team's, at mood Wary. "Is it the same rent?"

pen.clean: Clean hands: the doors are opened that night and the game doesn't ask.
pen.choice: Rocket's Pen is the team's to decide.
said: The doors are opened that night.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.name: Rocket's plan
scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

fall.hero: The Hero's reason was about Rocket. That evening it's rewritten in their own hand: it's about you now.

vault.title: A LEGEND IN THE VAULT
card: Nobody. The sea, perhaps. The sky.
The strongest Pokémon this team'll ever field.
Dread +3. Heat +4, and its floor's now 5. Every Kind Grunt's Loyalty −1.
Will hear by tomorrow. This is the day the Hero stops thinking the team's small.
Whether it wants to be here.
Open the ball. Regard +3. It goes. It looks at the Boss first.
vault.freed: Opened the ball. It looked at the Boss first, and went. The weather's right by morning; locals are one warmer.

neighbours.ground: The Goldenrod Department Store's roof, by the vending machines. Two cans of lemonade on the bench between the chairs. He's bought both. He hasn't opened his.
neighbours.refuses: Anything that'd mean giving up the chair. "It isn't mine to give."
neighbours.does: He's loyal. Nobody on his Roster's ever been sold out. Loyalty in his team reads as Devoted to a man, and the man's a photograph.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: The Slowpoke Well, back in Azalea. Proton.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: men in black at the Slowpoke Well in Azalea, and a child who ran them off. "Weren't they finished?"

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: The signal at the Lake of Rage. The lake's Magikarp are forced to evolve.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Lake of Rage has gone red. A Dragon Tamer and a child are on the shore. Rocket's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The Radio Tower, Goldenrod. The broadcast calling Giovanni home.
ticks.radio: On the Radio, for a minute, a different voice: Rocket, calling Giovanni home. The Tower's taken, and Goldenrod's got their people on its streets.

ticks.name: The hideout
ticks.text: The stair under the Mahogany souvenir shop. It's cleared.
ticks.radio: The hideout under the Mahogany souvenir shop's been cleared. The lake's still red this morning. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. The kits are restless.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: What's left of them, deciding whether to go home.
ticks.radio: The Hero climbed the Radio Tower and came down again. Rocket's colour comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening.

basket.text: A letter, in a very careful hand, three lines straight: "We are not presently in a position to contest your arrival. We would take it as a courtesy if the Radio Tower were left to us. A reply is not required. — Archer, Interim."
said: Nothing. It goes on the Mess wall. Somebody straightens it.
Sent back. Opinion: down a step. No reply. None was required.
A reply, though none was required. Opinion: up a step. He answers, three lines straight, every district.
There's nothing in it. Good paper. A very careful hand. "He's practised that."
basket.war: Another letter, at War, three lines straight. "We are not presently in a position to contest it. — Archer, Interim."
basket.chair: The last letter. "It was never mine. — Archer." He's left off the Interim.

rules.broken: You leaned on {holding}. He'd have called it untidy. {who}'s known the street forty years. I had to look it up. He'd have known.
One of yours came to us. You'd missed his pay. We've no money to pay him either. He stayed anyway. That's the difference.

rules.rule: Never take from someone who'll have nothing left
rules.broken: {holding}. You took the last of it. That was one of his rules. I keep them. Somebody has to.

first.opens: "Forgive me. I have to ask. I'd not forgive myself. ...Is it you?" You: "Is what me?" "No. No, of course. You'd be taller. I beg your pardon."
first.mess: "You leaned on {holding}. It was untidy. {who}'s known the street forty years. He'd have known that."
first.warm: "You haven't made a mess. I looked. He'd have looked."
first.book: "We've time on our hands. We watch. We used to keep a ledger. I still do. It's his format."
answers: He tells it. All of it. Three years. It's too long, and the second chair shifts in their seat. A Truce is offered.
He goes very still. "Is he well?" Whatever you tell him, he says: "That's his hand. ...He wrote all that down about you, and he never wrote to us." A Truce is offered.
"The broadcast's all we've got. If he's anywhere, he's somewhere with a radio." He won't trade the Tower. War, then, and he's sorry about it.
"I know." First time he's said it aloud. Petrel, behind the vending machine in a caretaker's coat, drops a mop. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "We are not presently in a position to contest anything. A line on the Board, and the Tower left to us. Or you could wear our colour. He'd have asked a tenth."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. Rocket's name on the door. Nothing else: they're broke.
What he'll ask you to do. Whether the man he's keeping the chair for would want you in it.
Say no. He'll write a letter about it.
frontSaid: "Fridays, then. That's how he did it." The team's holdings wear Rocket's colour as a stripe.
"No. I understand." He opens the lemonade, at last.
first.ask: "One question. I ask everyone; I'd not forgive myself. Why are you doing this? Not the Creed on your wall. The reason."
first.wrote: He writes it down in a very careful hand.

second.opens: "You came. Sit. The lemonade's still cold."
second.stands: He stands up. "Sit. No: after you. That's how it was done."
second.kept: "His rules. You've kept the three I'd have checked. I don't think he'd have expected that."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: He doesn't laugh. He looks at the photograph first.
pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one." He doesn't open it. "They're his. I'm keeping them for him. Everything here's his."

son.you: "The Tower. Top floor. He's asked for you."
lines: He's at the desk. The microphone's off.
Archer: "I've written it eleven ways. They all say come back."
You: "He isn't coming back. You know that."
said: The broadcast goes out. It says come back. The Hero climbs the Tower for it, and Proton turns it up.
"Not yet. After." He doesn't touch the switch.

He makes the broadcast anyway. It's shorter. It doesn't say come back. It says: "This is Archer. We kept it going. I wanted you to know someone did." Then he switches the transmitter off himself. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board.
son.stop: When the Hero climbed the Tower there was one man in it, sitting down, who said: "I've been expecting somebody. It's never who I expect."

table.line: A line on the Board. Neither crosses. Truce.
table.person: Traded. He writes the name down carefully. He doesn't say thank you; he bows.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "The signal. ...Fine. The lake can wait." The reach is called off; the broadcast comes two days late.
table.money: "A tenth. Accepted." He counts it twice. Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. He writes it down. "Thank you. Has the child a radio?"
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the child." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first. He takes both cans.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table. He won't trade the Tower.

asks.job: Turn the Mahogany transmitter up a notch.
asks.from: The Magikarp at the Lake of Rage.
asks.why: It makes them ill, then it makes them evolve. Lance is on his way.

asks.job: Stand watch on the Mahogany souvenir shop.
asks.from: Mrs. Sachiko Yamane, at the till.
asks.why: She'd rather not know what's under her floor. A squad on her step means she will.

asks.job: Lend six Grunts for the Radio Tower.
asks.from: The Tower's staff, held a day.
asks.why: It's the big job. The broadcast calls a man home who isn't coming. The team's uniforms are on the stairs when the Hero walks in.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "I understand. He'd have thought less of you." The Front ends. Rivals.

chair.says: "This chair isn't mine to lose. If you take it you'll be taking it from a man who isn't here. I thought you should know whose it is."
chair.won: Archer's beaten, in front of both Rosters. Rocket's Return is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Rocket's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Rocket's Return fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, smaller, with their Grunts asking what happens now.

betrayal.grabs: The transmitter. He turns it up.
betrayal.says: "Archer's waiting for a man. I'm not waiting for anybody."

fall.boss: Archer serves. He needs a chair to stand beside. He starts answering to his own name on the Roster sheet, and not "Interim."

admins.name: Archer
admins.says: Serves, as an Officer: Books and Nerve both. Loves someone on the other side, and the someone's a photograph.

admins.name: Proton
admins.says: The Betrayal. Giovanni's fourth rule's said aloud, by Archer. He can't ever be hired: his card's got no line at all.

fall.gruntsSaid: Ten want to stay. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. They ask if anyone's seen him.
fall.holdings: Rocket's holdings are the team's, at mood Wary. "Weren't they finished?"

pen.clean: Clean hands: the doors are opened that night and the game doesn't ask. The Slowpoke go home to Azalea.
pen.choice: Rocket's Pen is the team's to decide.
said: The doors are opened that night.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.name: The broadcast
scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

fall.hero: The Hero's reason was about Rocket. That evening it's rewritten in their own hand: it's about you now.

card: The strongest Pokémon this team'll field in Johto.
Dread +3. Heat +4, and its floor's now 5. Every Kind Grunt's Loyalty −1.

vault.freed: Opened the ball. It looked at the Boss first, and went back to the lake. The water's clear by morning; locals are one warmer.

neighbours.ground: His boat. It rocks. He doesn't notice.
neighbours.refuses: Anywhere indoors. "Can't hear the sea in a room."
neighbours.does: He eats with his crew. Every night. Same table. Aqua's Mess is the model for the team's own.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: The Devon goods. Then the Oceanic Museum.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: Devon's goods taken on the road, and men in bandanas asking questions at the Oceanic Museum.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: Mt. Chimney. Aqua goes up to stop Magma's machine.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: a fight on Mt. Chimney, both colours, and a child at the top. Aqua's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The Weather Institute. Aqua takes it.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Weather Institute's been taken by men in bandanas. Fortree's got their people on its streets.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The Orb from Mt. Pyre, and the sea.
ticks.radio: Rain on the east half of Hoenn, drought on the west. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. The kits are restless.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: Sootopolis. Wallace on the steps.
ticks.radio: The Hero walked into Aqua's cove and out again. Aqua's colour comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening.

basket.text: Shouted through a loudhailer from the bay: "AHOY! WELCOME ASHORE! DON'T TRUST THE HOODS! — A!" An hour later a typed letter comes from the other one, with a footnote, saying the same about him.
said: Nothing. The whole street heard it. The Mess talks about nothing else at supper.
Sent word back. Opinion: down a step. "Suit yourself!" across the bay.
Shouted back, from the end of the jetty. Opinion: up a step. He roars laughing. It goes back and forth all region.
There's nothing in it. It's exactly what it sounds like. "That's worse, somehow."
basket.war: The loudhailer again, at War: "STILL HERE! — A!"
basket.chair: The last shout across the bay: "FAIR AND SQUARE! — A!"

rules.broken: You leaned on {holding}! My lads drink there! {who}'s a friend of the sea!
One of yours came to my table. Hungry. Said you'd missed his pay. He's eating with us now. Every night.
{holding}. You took the last of it. I've sent it back. Don't do it again.

rules.rule: More sea, for the ones that need it

first.opens: "He'd pave it! Every beach! You've seen his Grunts, they wear hoods in summer. Tell me you're not with the hoods."
first.mess: "And you leaned on {holding}! My lads drink there! {who}'s a friend of the sea!"
first.warm: "I asked about you on the docks. Nobody's got a word against you. That's rare round here."
first.book: "Docks talk. Everything ends up on a dock. When it's done, when there's more of it: where'll your people live?"
answers: "Ha! I knew it! Shake on it!" He means the handshake. A Truce is offered.
"...We don't talk." A long while. "I'd write. If somebody asked. I'd not post it." A Truce is offered.
"Neither! Then you're in the way, mate." War, on him. He's not angry. He sends a crate of fish anyway.
He opens his mouth. He shuts it. He's never asked it about his own plan. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "Join us on the hoods. War on Magma, the two of us. Or wear our colour and pay a tenth into the pot. Same pot I eat from."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. Aqua's boats. A place at his table.

Say no. He'll shout about it, then forget.

"Suit yourself!" He doesn't stay cross. He can't.
first.ask: "One more, and it's the one I ask my crew. Why are you doing this? Not the painted bit. The real reason."
first.wrote: He doesn't write it down. He says he'll remember. He does.

second.stands: He stands up. The boat tips. "Sit! No: you first. Guests first on my boat."
second.kept: "You've kept your crew fed and your streets whole. I'd have checked. I did check."

pen.laughs: "Pen? It's not a pen, it's a rescue!"
pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one." Then he opens the lot. "Rescued's rescued. They can go home."

lines: He writes it, if asked. It's four lines. The spelling's bad.
"MAX. Remember the trip to Sootopolis. You were sick on the boat. I held your glasses. I still got the case you left. — A"
He won't post it. He hands it to you.
said: Lux steams it open and seals it after. Archie knows at once, by the flap. He laughs.
Kept. Leverage, on both. It's on the Ledger.

Carried, both ways, in person. They meet at the Weather Institute, which they were both about to take. Matt and Tabitha stand outside, not knowing where to look. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board.
son.stop: When the Hero beat him, Archie asked one thing, about a glasses case. Nobody in the room knew what he meant.

table.person: Handed over. He claps them on the back and gives them a bunk.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first. It's his boat: you leave first.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Carry a crate of Devon goods to Slateport. Don't open it.
asks.why: It's the Devon goods. The Oceanic Museum's next.

asks.job: Lend six Grunts for the Weather Institute.
asks.from: Dr. Solveig Aarons and the Institute's staff, held a day.
asks.why: It's the big job. The team's uniforms are in the hall when the Hero walks in.

asks.job: Fetch the Orb from Mt. Pyre.
asks.from: The old couple who guard it.
asks.why: "The last lot said they'd bring it back too." Every Kind on the Roster refuses.

askSaid.did: Done. It's on the Ledger under the team's name. The Card for it had "The other way" filled in, and you read it.
askSaid.no: "Then you're no sailor!" The Front ends. Rivals.

chair.says: "Winner gets the lot! Loser gets a berth, a bunk and three squares, same as any of mine. Shake on it."
chair.won: Archie's beaten, in front of both Rosters. He shakes on it. Aqua is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Aqua's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Archie fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, smaller, with his Grunts asking what happens now.

betrayal.grabs: The submarine. She's read the Orb's notes and Archie hasn't.
betrayal.says: "I'm not betraying you, Archie. I'm stopping you. You'll thank me from the brig."

fall.boss: Archie asks to be a Grunt. He's good at it. He calls the Boss "Cap'n" and means it.

admins.name: Matt
admins.says: Follows Archie anywhere, including down a rank.

admins.name: Shelly
admins.says: The Betrayal. She was right, and too late. "Won't sign what I haven't read."

fall.gruntsSaid: Twenty want to stay. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. They ask where the Mess is.
fall.holdings: Aqua's holdings are the team's, at mood Wary. "Is it the same rent?"

pen.clean: Clean hands: the doors are opened that night and the game doesn't ask.
pen.choice: Aqua's Pen is the team's to decide. He called it a rescue.
said: The doors are opened that night. Twelve, all Water, back to the sea.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.name: More sea
scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

fall.hero: The Hero's reason was about Aqua. That evening it's rewritten in their own hand: it's about you now.

vault.title: A LEGEND IN THE VAULT
card: The strongest Pokémon this team'll ever field.
Dread +3. Heat +4, and its floor's now 5. Every Kind Grunt's Loyalty −1.
Will hear by tomorrow. This is the day the Hero stops thinking the team's small.
Whether it wants to be here.
Open the ball. Regard +3. It goes. It looks at the Boss first.
vault.freed: Opened the ball. It looked at the Boss first, and went. The weather's right by morning; locals are one warmer. Archie sends one line: "You had it. In your hand. And you opened your hand. I couldn't've."

neighbours.ground: The rim. A folding table. A thermos.
neighbours.refuses: Anywhere damp. "I shan't. It gets into the paper."
neighbours.does: He writes everything down and shows his working. A Magma Grunt always knows why.

ticks.name: The first move
ticks.text: The Devon goods. The Oceanic Museum.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: Devon's goods taken on the road, and men in hoods asking after them at the Oceanic Museum.

ticks.name: The reach
ticks.text: Mt. Chimney. The machine in the crater.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: a machine in the crater on Mt. Chimney, a fight in both colours, and a child at the top. Magma's Dread +2.

ticks.name: The big job
ticks.text: The Weather Institute. Magma was on the road to it too.
ticks.radio: On the Radio: the Weather Institute's been taken. Fortree's got both teams' people on its streets.

ticks.name: The Legend
ticks.text: The Orb from Mt. Pyre, and the mountain.
ticks.radio: Drought on the west half of Hoenn, rain on the east. Every holding's one mood colder for a day. The kits are restless.

ticks.name: The fall
ticks.text: Sootopolis. Wallace on the steps.
ticks.radio: The Hero walked into the Jagged Pass and out again. Magma's colour comes off the Board, holding by holding, over an evening.

basket.text: A typed letter with a footnote: "Archie cannot be trusted.¹ — M." The footnote's longer than the letter. An hour before, the other one shouted the same about him through a loudhailer.
said: Nothing. It goes in a drawer. The footnote's cited twice at supper.
Sent back. Opinion: down a step. It comes back again, annotated.
Written back. Opinion: up a step. He replies with a corrected copy of your letter. It goes back and forth all region.
Somebody reads the footnote. All of it. It's right. "That's worse, somehow."
basket.war: Another typed letter, at War, with two footnotes. "— M."
basket.chair: The last letter. Typed. No footnote. "Well done. — M."

rules.broken: You leaned on {holding}. I have it in my notes. {who} has a bad chest. It's in my notes too.
One of yours came to me. You'd missed his pay and told him nothing. A Grunt should always know why. He knows why now.

rules.rule: Never take from someone who'll have nothing left
rules.broken: {holding}. You took the last of it. I have returned it, with a note. The note is three pages.

rules.rule: More land, for the ones that can't swim

first.opens: "He would drown a city to make room for a Wailmer. I have the tide tables. I can show you which city."
first.mess: "You leaned on {holding}. It's in my notes. {who} has a bad chest. That's in my notes too."
first.warm: "You've made no mess. I checked. I check everything."
first.book: "I write everything down. When it's done, when there's more of it: where will your people live?"
answers: "Good. I've drawn up terms." A Truce is offered.
"We have not spoken in six years." A pause. "I would write. If asked. I would not post it." A Truce is offered.
"Then you are an obstacle, and I plan for obstacles." War, on him. It's in his notes by evening.
He takes off his glasses. He cleans them. He's never asked it about his own plan. Opinion: up.
first.offer: "Join me against the sea. Or wear our colour and pay a tenth. The terms are four pages. You may read them now or afterwards."
frontCard: A tenth of takings, every seventh day. Your name off your own door.
Heat −1 a day, floor 2. Magma's papers. His working, shown.
What he'll ask you to do. It's on page four.
frontSaid: "Agreed. I'll file it." The team's holdings wear Magma's colour as a stripe.
"Noted." He writes it down. He doesn't look disappointed.
first.ask: "One question, and I'll write down the answer. Why are you doing this? Not the slogan. The reason."
first.wrote: He writes it down, and underlines it.

second.opens: "You came. Sit. There's tea in the thermos."
second.stands: He stands up. "Sit. No: after you. It's in the terms."
second.kept: "You've kept the three I'd have checked. I checked. I didn't expect that."

profit: "Money. It's honest. It's the only thing that is."
"Because somebody's going to own this street, and it'll be somebody worse."
cause: "Because the people who run this region won't fix it."
"Somebody has to be the one who's wrong out loud."
power: "To find out how far it goes."
wonder: "There's something out there nobody's allowed to see. I want to see it."
"Because the old stories were true, and nobody's looking."
belonging: "Because these sixteen haven't got anybody else."
"Because nobody ever picked us. So we picked each other."
spite: "Because somebody once told me I wouldn't."
"So they'll have to look at me."

pen.laughs: "It's a collection. Every case is labelled."
pen.goOn: "Nine. All in labelled cases. Go on."
pen.empty: He's quiet. "You've never kept one." He reads you the labels, all nine. He doesn't open a case.

lines: Maxie: "We have not spoken in six years."
He writes it, if asked. It's two pages, typed, with a diagram.
The last line's handwritten, cramped, added after: "I did not leave the case. I gave it to you. You were always losing yours."
He won't post it. He hands it to you.
said: Lux steams it open and seals it after. Maxie knows at once, by the flap. He never speaks to the Boss again.
Kept. Leverage, on both. It's on the Ledger.

Carried, both ways, in person. They meet at the Weather Institute, which they were both about to take. Matt and Tabitha stand outside, not knowing where to look. Stance: Understanding. It's on the Ledger and not on the Board.
son.stop: When the Hero beat him, Maxie asked one thing, about a glasses case. He wrote the answer down.

table.line: A line on the Board, drawn with a ruler. Neither crosses. Truce.
table.person: Handed over. He makes a note of the name. He nods.
table.minor: Minors are never on the table. The slot refuses them.
table.job: "Mt. Chimney. ...Fine. I'll revise the schedule." The reach is called off; the big job comes two days late.
table.money: "A tenth. Receipted." Opinion: up a step.
table.fact: Where the Hero is. He writes it down. "Thank you. It matches my notes."
table.promise: "Neither of us touches the child." "Agreed." Every one of them agrees.

sitDown.rise: He leaves first. He folds the table.
sitDown.noTable: Nothing else goes on the table.

asks.job: Lend a squad to the drill on the mountain.
asks.from: Lavaridge. The spring's a degree hotter than last year.
asks.why: Somebody's drilling the mountain. It's Flannery's Bend.

chair.says: "I've drawn up terms. They're four pages. You may read them now or afterwards; they're the same either way and I shall abide by them."
chair.won: Maxie's beaten, in front of both Rosters. He abides by the terms. Magma is the team's.
chair.lost: Lost, in front of both Rosters. Soft loss: the team isn't ended. It's Magma's: a Merger the wrong way up. One order a district.
chair.again: One more try, in the next district.
chair.free: Maxie fell to the Hero. The team's its own again, smaller, with his Grunts asking what happens now.

betrayal.grabs: The Orb. She wants to see what happens.
betrayal.says: "...Analysing. ...I want to watch. ...Don't you want to watch?"

fall.boss: Maxie asks to be a Grunt. He's dreadful at it. He files a report on his first job that's longer than the Ledger. Hortense reads it. All of it. "It's very thorough, love. Eat something."

admins.name: Tabitha
admins.says: Joins if he's made an Officer on the day. He is.

admins.name: Courtney
admins.says: Joins. Eyes. Her card's flaw field reads "Curious," and it fires at Digs.

fall.gruntsSaid: Eighteen want to stay. {beds} take a bed. The rest wait at the Town. They ask to see the working.
fall.holdings: Magma's holdings are the team's, at mood Wary. "Is it the same rent?"

pen.choice: Magma's Pen is the team's to decide. Nine labelled cases.
said: The cases are opened that night.
Kept. It's on the Ledger.

scheme.other: Don't. It was never a good idea.

lines.off: There's no neighbour in this build.
lines.inPersonOnly: In person only: at the In person beat.
lines.outToday: The Boss has already been out today.
lines.once: One Sit-Down a district. A second needs a reason he accepts.
lines.chairShut: The Chair opens after a Sit-Down, or at War with the count in the team's favour.
lines.chairDone: The Chair's been tried, and the next try waits for the next district.
lines.chairMinors: Children can't be challenged for a chair.
lines.legendDone: The Legend's been met this region.
lines.brokeSaid: A job across the Truce's line. Stance: Rivals. Opinion down two. It travels.
lines.warStep: A war job. Stance one step toward War: {stance}.
lines.quiet: A quiet district. Stance one step back: {stance}.
lines.slowed: The war's going the team's way. Rocket's clock slows four days.
lines.stopped: Tick {n} didn't happen. The next comes two days late.
lines.invite: A message: "Tomorrow. The same room. Bring your count. — G."
lines.ask: A job on the Board in Rocket's colour: {job}
lines.betrayalRadio: On the Radio: {who} made a grab. {grabs}
lines.race: The Betrayal's tonight. Whoever gets to the cave first. Go in person.
lines.heroLegend: The Hero met the Legend in the cave. Whether they've got it with them at the Reckoning is theirs to know.
lines.caught: Caught. It's in the ball. Read the Card in the morning.
lines.notCaught: It got away. The cave is quiet now.
lines.legendLost: Lost to it. The party is healed; nothing ends. It's gone from the cave.
lines.pick: Up/Down picks. Enter answers. Esc closes.
